scope: Native iPhone compact landscape title/three-paragraph note insertion, complete active input line, keyboard-visible Save, exact normal process relaunch; normal/light and accessibility XXXL/dark.
productionChange: iOS TaskEditor keeps one focused compact editing line with reduced row insets, uses a 48-point labelled compact keyboard-dismiss button, and scrolls the focused row into the available viewport after focus/keyboard layout changes. Portrait/unfocused multiline content remains available. No persistence or Mac production changes.

checks: Native typing inserts the entire string while preserving the preexisting text.
Both active inputs have nonempty hittable frames wholly above the dismiss bar and below the actual toolbar controls.
Dismiss button is at least 44 points high and above the onscreen keyboard.
Save is enabled and hittable with the keyboard visible.
Normal relaunch reopens the same task with exact edited title and multiline notes.

initialAttempts: v2 functional largest pass was visually rejected because the notes/caret were obscured.
v6 two green cases were rejected: CGRect.contains accepted an empty accessibility frame; final assertions require nonempty and hittable fields.
v3-v5/v7-v10 included text-menu driver failures and a too-strict navigation-bar padding bound.
v11 native Command-A did not select the title, prefixing the insertion. Selection/replacement is not accepted. Final tests exercise native insertion without requiring Select All.
limits: This closes the named compact keyboard editing visibility/Save/relaunch journey, not text-selection gestures or every editor/layout combination.
Spoken VoiceOver, installed Mac widgets/privacy redaction, notification actions/APNs, external provider transfer, selected concurrency/failure variants and production distribution remain open.
Mac production code is unchanged because the compact onscreen-keyboard layout is iOS-specific. Independent repository ownership remains intact.
storage: 244.2 MiB duplicate exports pruned; original xcresult bundles and selected public fixture captures retained.
